grammar.summary: 本课学习 a little/a few 与 catch fire 等固定搭配。

points.title: a little 与 a few
points.explanation: a little + 不可数（a little time），a few + 复数（a few minutes）。本课马戏场景描写高频使用。

examples.en: She had a little time to escape.

points.title: catch fire 表"着火"
points.explanation: catch fire = 燃起来（瞬间）；on fire = 着火状态；set fire to = 点燃。三个 fire 短语各有分工。
